description: A focused study of whether a proposed project can work: purpose and need, concepts, evaluation against agreed criteria, and a recommendation the sponsor can act on.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the notice-to-proceed date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
The single most important record here is the criteria milestone. A study whose evaluation criteria are agreed after the concepts exist will be argued about rather than used.
It stops short of design. A study that recommends a project usually hands off to environmental review and then to design — those are separate work plans.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and schedule
deliverables.summary: The task list, the schedule and the decision the study is meant to inform.

deliverables.title: Purpose and need statement
deliverables.summary: The problem in the sponsor's own words, agreed before concepts are drawn.

deliverables.title: Existing conditions summary
deliverables.summary: What is true at the site today — physical, operational, environmental and ownership — with sources named.

deliverables.title: Concept alternatives
deliverables.summary: The concepts considered, each described well enough to be evaluated and costed at a planning level by your team.

deliverables.title: Evaluation matrix and findings
deliverables.summary: Every concept scored against the agreed criteria, with the reasoning shown.

deliverables.title: Draft feasibility report
deliverables.summary: The complete draft, including the recommendation and what it depends on.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, schedule and the decision to be informed confirmed.

milestones.title: Evaluation criteria agreed
milestones.summary: The criteria and their weighting settled in writing before concepts are compared.

milestones.title: Stakeholder review of concepts
milestones.summary: Affected agencies and owners see the concepts before the draft recommends one.

milestones.title: Public information meeting
milestones.summary: The concepts and the recommendation shown publicly.

milestones.title: Study accepted by the sponsor
milestones.summary: The sponsor accepts the study and decides whether to proceed.
